en: Black‑and‑white view through an old city gate with a large rounded arch opening onto a cobbled street lined with multi‑storey townhouses. Above and to the right of the arch is a baroque‑style niche containing a seated crowned figure in relief, flanked by two standing figures with spears. Several German signs are attached to the wall by the arch. The overall scene suggests a historic European city street photographed in an early 20th‑century style.
